cross_axis_profile.note: Same exact mask and fraction, measured along the other axis. Compare long traces with local junction peaks; neither is a wall label. For bindable C IDs on this axis, request a profile using this axis.

crop_context.note: Edge intervals are matching pixels on the crop border (right/bottom are exclusive box limits, so samples are at right-1/bottom-1). A crop edge is not an object endpoint. declaration.panel_note: Left is the untouched original crop. Right is an exact color-distance mask: magenta outlines candidate bands; blue marks only actual support at the peak coordinate. Marks are coordinate references, not entities. Right-panel local coordinates correspond to the same original crop after removing its combined-image offset.
declaration.evidence_note: Support intervals are measured only at each candidate peak. They do not prove a whole band is continuous or identify a wall. Filtered or empty results do not prove an object is absent.
declaration.display_note: For a returned-image point (rx, ry), first multiply by original_pixels_per_returned_pixel to obtain full combined-image coordinates (fx, fy). On the left, original image coordinates are (box_left + fx, box_top + fy). On the right, subtract mask_panel_combined_pixels[0] from fx before adding box_left. Prefer candidates and support intervals, which already use original-image coordinates.
